selection_rule.FF_policy: Inherited Y/Y problems disclosed, not used to favor a generated outcome or to certify a globally clean source
selection_rule.eligibility: Existing NEW32 reviewed upper sitting surface; AI_PROXY region review, valid source mapping, N128..256, 0<K<N, one C component; inherited C/C and C/Y illegal=UNKNOWN=0; parent/group/exact geometry outside EXP67
selection_rule.fixed_order: SEAT_FULL then SEAT_HALF; parent_id then condition_id lexicographic; first two eligible of each type; four distinct parents
selection_rule.noise: One RandomState(seed).randn(1,N,9).astype(float32); save original full-N array; inference z copies it and zeroes known slots for old.read_input; free is the original [K:] slice
selection_rule.query_policy: Reuse exact existing per-C points, weights and complete query array; rebind only metadata identity to unchanged C __base variant
selection_rule.seed: SHA256(namespace + slash + request_id), first four bytes little endian; collision fails preparation without redraw
selection_rule.unknown_near_duplicates: Not exhaustively screened. Use existing group/exact hash and published PAIR04 near-duplicate warning; no new pairwise geometry search.

historical_parent_coordinate_transform.note: Internal recenter operations belong to ONE official full-object preprocessing call. Patches never normalized separately. Stored raw geometry is unmodified.
historical_parent_coordinate_transform.operation_sequence: official FP32 operations: (raw-center1)/divisor1; subtract center2; (result-center3)/divisor3; clip; divide .3762; model multiply 2
